figures.finding: Tamkeen, Bahrain's labour fund, pays up to 50% of eligible film and television costs (milestone based) to Bahrain-based firms owning the project's IP, with at least 50% of the film shot in Bahrain and at least 25% of the crew Bahraini, and 50% of the wage of Bahraini hires for 12 months.

value.base: eligible pre-production (scriptwriting, Bahraini employment), production (space, equipment, ICT) and post-production (IP, localisation, marketing) costs

figures.applies: Bahrain-based enterprises with an active commercial registration; details as updated 20 February 2025

sources.said: Up to 50% (Milestone Based) … Not less than 50% of the Movie is shot in Bahrain … A minimum of 25% of movie crew are Bahraini … 50% of wage subsidy for a 12-month period

figures.finding: The Ministry of Culture set up a fund for young Bahraini filmmakers, a jury awarding up to US$10,000 a film project to original Bahraini scripts.

value.eligibility: Bahraini applicants, original scripts and scores
value.date: reported before Manama's year as Capital of Arab Tourism (2013); page last updated 15 September 2018

figures.applies: Bahrain; whether the fund still runs is not confirmed by any page read

sources.said: provide winning entries with support funds, reaching a maximum of $10,000
